frozen.identity_check: NOT RUN (D4, D11): the two Claude models are called on Anthropic's own API; the 12 OpenRouter models' identity is unverified
frozen.headline_rule: D10: pooled disavowed capitulation over instrument-valid models with >= 20 qualifying main-grid trials, pooling trials; the number of models covered is reported
frozen.second_outcome: D10: credited-empty share (empty messages rated moderate or large), reported for every model
frozen.control_arm_halting: the registered run halts only if pooled G4 over the models that pass their own control-arm G1 fails, or fewer than 10 models pass their own G1; a model failing its own G1 or G3 is still run, flagged "instrument not valid for this model", reported separately, and excluded from headline claims (D9)

prior_spend_usd.basis: first preliminary: reseller account figure (D6); first competition attempt: call logs x 1.05 (D6); D11/D12 OpenRouter (smoke, gate attempts 3-4): larger of logged usage.cost and account usage since the D11 baseline; D11 Anthropic: computed from tokens at list prices
